title: An `abstract` method with a body compiles, and acts as an ordinary method.
text: `public abstract function area(): int { return 1; }` in an `abstract` class passes `nvs check`. A subclass that does not declare `area` compiles too, and a call runs the body. `abstract` there says nothing. It closes when a body on an `abstract` method is a diagnostic, with a conformance case.
